Question 2

The displacement s of a particle moving in a straight line is given by s(t)=3−6t2+2t3. Find the particle's acceleration at time t.

a
a(t)=12(2−t)
b
a(t)=6t(t+2)
c
a(t)=6t(t−2)
d
a(t)=12(t+1)
e
a(t)=12(t−1)
